description:
This is a Data Analyst role reporting to Data Architect in Boston MA. 
 Work on Client migration (on boarding) Projects as a Data Analyst or Business Analyst responsible for Business Requirements document clearly articulating the data requirements, data analysis, data gaps, Standard Out bounds (Extracts, Interactive Views, Client Reports), Custom Out bounds  

 Coordination with US /UK/India Project teams and third-party vendors or SSC Business units and the Clients
 Requirements Analysis, Data Flows, Data Mapping exercise to the source systems
 Flexibility to work in UK/India time zones (when required)
 Train new resources
 


 At least 6 Yrs of Total IT experience
 Min 2 Yrs of experience in working as a Data Analyst / Database Developer
   Data Modelling experience;  Process Modelling, Data Flow documentation 
 Query Optimization Techniques
 Financial Services back ground is a must
 Good understanding of middle office services – a plus
   Proficient in SQL; Data Modelling;  Basic Java Programming 
 Data Mapping, Identification of the right source for the standard out bounds, elimination of data redundancies, Data Profiling, Traceability
 Data Quality, creating control scripts to identify data quality issues thru the operational control framework ; Data Management  
 Work closely with Business Users, Development Team and the BUAT Team on any assignment
 State Street IMS application experience – Desirable
